sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head and mandibles black, the underside of the head pale brown; antenna 7 mm long, when bent backward only slightly surpassing the occiput or just reaching it; dorsum of the abdomen dark brown, venter pale yellowish brown. Measurements: total length 16, head with mandibles 9, hind tibia 5 mm. Type locality Umangi, Congo (collected by E. Wilverth; deposited in the Brussels and Stockholm museums).

note: Adapted from the original description by Sjöstedt 1899 (in German, published under Termes as Termes amplus n. sp.); only the major soldier is described, the worker and the alate not being treated; the measurements are the millimetre values of the original (which gives the figures without the unit mm). The original was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan, and individual letters are wrong (heil for hell).
